'''Gub Tengo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]].

==Biography==
During the reign of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Chagras]], Tengo worked in a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapons]] factory, where his job was to inject [[Poison/Legends|poison]] into spores. However, he eventually lost the use of his legs as a result of a vat collapse. Following the ascent to power on Darkknell of the Sith Daiman, Tengo was given a new job, altering old documents to make them conform with the [[Daimanite alphabet]]. By [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Tengo was living in an apartment in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Xakrea]] with his granddaughter [[Tan Tengo]], and he hired the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Kerra Holt]] to look after Tan.
